convert-xml-to-pdf.title: Convert XML to PDF with Default XSLT Transformation
convert-xml-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file using Aspose.Pdf.XmlLoadOptions and saving it as a PDF, applying the default XSLT transformation.

create-pdf-from-xsl-fo-memory-stream.title: Create PDF from XML Using MemoryStream
create-pdf-from-xsl-fo-memory-stream.description: Demonstrates loading XML from a MemoryStream, binding it to an Aspose.Pdf Document, and saving the result as a PDF with default settings.

convert-xml-to-pdf-with-xslt.title: Convert XML to PDF using XSL‑FO with Aspose.Pdf
convert-xml-to-pdf-with-xslt.description: Demonstrates applying an XSLT stylesheet to XML to generate XSL‑FO and then converting that FO to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's core API.

validate-xml-xsd-before-pdf-generation.title: Validate XML Against XSD Before PDF Generation
validate-xml-xsd-before-pdf-generation.description: Demonstrates how to validate an XML file against an XSD schema using XmlReaderSettings and, upon successful validation, generate a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-page-size-from-xml.title: Set PDF Page Size from XML
set-pdf-page-size-from-xml.description: Shows how to read page width and height values from an XML file and apply them to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-page-orientation-from-xml.title: Create PDF Pages with Orientation from XML
set-pdf-page-orientation-from-xml.description: Loads an XML layout, reads the orientation attribute for each <Page> element, and generates a PDF where each page is sized as portrait or landscape accordingly.

set-custom-page-margins-from-xml.title: Set Custom Page Margins from XML per Section
set-custom-page-margins-from-xml.description: Demonstrates loading margin definitions from an XML file and applying them to specific page ranges in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-automatic-page-numbers-pdf-xslt.title: Insert Automatic Page Numbers into PDF via XSLT
insert-automatic-page-numbers-pdf-xslt.description: Demonstrates how to convert a PDF to XML, apply an XSLT transformation that adds page numbers, and convert the modified XML back to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

generate-pdf-table-from-xml.title: Generate PDF Table from XML Data
generate-pdf-table-from-xml.description: Demonstrates loading tabular data from an XML file, creating an Aspose.Pdf table, populating it with header and rows, and saving the result as a PDF report.

preserve-cdata-to-pdf.title: Render XML with CDATA Sections to PDF
preserve-cdata-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load an XML file, recursively traverse its nodes, and write the XML structure—including CDATA sections with distinct background styling—to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-custom-font-to-xml-elements.title: Apply Custom Font to Specific XML Elements in PDF
apply-custom-font-to-xml-elements.description: Shows how to load an XML file, register a custom TrueType font with Aspose.Pdf, and apply that font to selected XML elements (e.g., <Important>) while converting the XML structure into a PDF document.

embed-custom-truetype-font-into-pdf.title: Embed Custom TrueType Font into PDF from XML
embed-custom-truetype-font-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file into an Aspose.Pdf Document, opening a custom TrueType font, applying it to all text fragments, and saving the PDF with the font embedded.

apply-css-from-xml-to-pdf.title: Apply External CSS Stylesheets to PDF
apply-css-from-xml-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an XML/HTML file that references external CSS files and converting it to a styled PDF using Aspose.Pdf's HtmlLoadOptions to resolve relative CSS paths.

convert-styled-html-to-pdf-with-custom-c.title: Apply Custom Color Scheme to PDF Text via XML
convert-styled-html-to-pdf-with-custom-c.description: The example reads a text color defined in an XML style file and applies that color to all text fragments in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-xml-color-to-pdf-page-background.title: Apply XML-defined Background Color to PDF Pages
apply-xml-color-to-pdf-page-background.description: Shows how to read a hex color from an XML file and set it as the background color for each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-header-footer-to-pdf-using-xml-templ.title: Add Header and Footer to PDF Using XML Template
add-header-footer-to-pdf-using-xml-templ.description: Reads header and footer text from an XML file and adds them to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf TextStamp objects.

add-background-images-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply Background Images to PDF Pages from XML
add-background-images-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to read an XML mapping of page numbers to image files and apply those images as background stamps to the corresponding pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-dynamic-page-headers-from-xml.title: Insert Dynamic Page Headers from XML into PDF
insert-dynamic-page-headers-from-xml.description: Shows how to read per‑page header text from an XML file and add it as a TextFragment to each PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-footnotes-from-xml.title: Insert Footnotes into PDF from XML
insert-footnotes-from-xml.description: Loads footnote definitions from an XML file and adds them as small text fragments to the specified pages of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-conditional-page-breaks-based-on-.title: Insert Conditional Page Breaks in PDF Based on XML Length
insert-conditional-page-breaks-based-on-.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file, iterating over paragraph elements, and inserting page breaks in a PDF when the accumulated text length exceeds a defined threshold using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-toc-from-xml.title: Create PDF Table of Contents from XML Headings
create-pdf-toc-from-xml.description: Shows how to generate a Table of Contents page in a PDF by reading a heading hierarchy from an XML file and adding clickable links that navigate to the corresponding pages using Aspose.Pdf.

create-hierarchical-pdf-outline-from-xml.title: Create Hierarchical PDF Outline from XML
create-hierarchical-pdf-outline-from-xml.description: Loads an XML file and generates a PDF whose outline hierarchy mirrors the XML element structure, using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-outlines-from-xml-section-tit.title: Create PDF Outline from XML Section Titles
create-pdf-outlines-from-xml-section-tit.description: Shows how to read section titles from an XML file, add a page for each title, and generate corresponding PDF outline (bookmark) entries for navigation.

create-pdf-outline-from-xml.title: Create PDF Outline Hierarchy from XML Structure
create-pdf-outline-from-xml.description: Loads an XML file that defines a nested structure and generates matching PDF outlines (bookmarks) with Aspose.Pdf, linking each outline to a page in the document.

add-page-transitions-to-pdf-from-xml.title: Create Presentation Mode PDF from XML
add-page-transitions-to-pdf-from-xml.description: Loads an XML file as a PDF, sets the document to open in full‑screen presentation mode, and saves the result.

set-pdf-page-duration-from-xml.title: Set PDF Page Transition Durations from XML
set-pdf-page-duration-from-xml.description: Loads timing values from an XML file and applies page transition types and durations to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, employing reflection to access the PdfPageEditor class without a direct Facades reference.

generate-pdf-from-xml-fullscreen.title: Generate PDF from XML with Full‑Screen Viewer Mode
generate-pdf-from-xml-fullscreen.description: Shows how to load an XML file into an Aspose.Pdf Document, set the viewer to full‑screen mode, and save the result as a PDF.

set-pdf-viewer-preferences-xml-to-pdf.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences When Converting XML to PDF
set-pdf-viewer-preferences-xml-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates converting an XML file to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and configuring viewer preferences such as FitWindow and PageLayout, employing dynamic typing to stay compatible with older library versions.

generate-pdf-from-xml-pdf-1-7.title: Generate PDF version 1.7 from XML
generate-pdf-from-xml-pdf-1-7.description: Shows how to load XML data into an Aspose.Pdf Document, convert it to PDF version 1.7 for compatibility, and save the resulting PDF file.

set-pdf-permissions-and-encrypt-xml-pdf.title: Restrict Printing and Copying in PDF Generated from XML
set-pdf-permissions-and-encrypt-xml-pdf.description: The example loads an XML file, converts it to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, and applies security settings that disable printing and content copying by setting permissions to none and encrypting the document with AES‑256.

encrypt-pdf-from-xml.title: Apply DRM Encryption to PDF Generated from XML
encrypt-pdf-from-xml.description: The example loads an XML file, converts it to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, and applies DRM protection by setting permissions and encrypting the document using AES‑256.

compress-pdf-streams-using-aspose-pdf.title: Compress PDF Streams Using Aspose.Pdf Optimization
compress-pdf-streams-using-aspose-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF generated from XML and applying Aspose.Pdf optimization to compress streams and images, reducing the file size.

compress-pdf-text-streams-flate-xml.title: Compress PDF Text Streams Using Flate via XML Conversion
compress-pdf-text-streams-flate-xml.description: Shows how to convert a PDF to XML, reload it, apply Flate compression to text streams through resource optimization, and save the reduced‑size PDF.

compress-pdf-text-objects-from-xml.title: Compress PDF Streams Generated from XML
compress-pdf-text-objects-from-xml.description: Loads an XML file, renders its elements as text fragments in a PDF, and then compresses the PDF streams using Aspose.Pdf's OptimizeResources method to reduce file size.

downsample-images-from-xml.title: Downsample Images from XML and Optimize PDF
downsample-images-from-xml.description: The example reads image file paths from an XML document, adds each image to a separate PDF page, and then down‑samples and compresses the images using Aspose.Pdf optimization options to produce a smaller PDF.

export-pdf-pages-high-resolution-png.title: Export PDF Pages to PNG with Custom Resolution
export-pdf-pages-high-resolution-png.description: Loads a PDF document from its XML representation and exports each page as a PNG image using a specified DPI resolution.

extract-base64-images-from-xml-to-pdf.title: Decode Base64 Images from XML and Embed into PDF
extract-base64-images-from-xml-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file with base64‑encoded images, decoding each image, and placing it on a separate PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

render-svg-from-xml-to-pdf.title: Render SVG Elements from XML as Vector Graphics in PDF
render-svg-from-xml-to-pdf.description: Loads an XML file containing <svg> elements, converts each SVG to a PDF page preserving vector graphics, and merges them into a single PDF document.

render-html-cdata-to-pdf.title: Render HTML CDATA Fragments to PDF
render-html-cdata-to-pdf.description: Loads an XML file, extracts HTML fragments stored in CDATA sections, renders each fragment to PDF pages with Aspose.Pdf, and combines them into a single PDF document.

embed-videos-from-xml-into-pdf.title: Embed Video Annotations from XML into PDF
embed-videos-from-xml-into-pdf.description: Loads an XML file that describes video files and their positions, then creates RichMedia annotations in a PDF and embeds the videos for interactive playback.

embed-audio-annotations-from-xml.title: Embed Audio Annotations from XML into PDF
embed-audio-annotations-from-xml.description: Shows how to read an XML file that defines audio files and their positions, then embed those audio clips as SoundAnnotation objects into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

embed-3d-models-from-xml.title: Embed 3D Model as Rich Media Annotation in PDF
embed-3d-models-from-xml.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file with 3D model references, creating RichMediaAnnotations on specified PDF pages, and attaching the model files (using reflection for version‑agnostic support).

add-javascript-actions-to-pdf-from-xml.title: Embed JavaScript Validation in PDF Generated from XML
add-javascript-actions-to-pdf-from-xml.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file into a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, adding a text box form field, and attaching JavaScript actions for field validation and a document‑level welcome alert.

create-pdf-xfa-form-from-xml.title: Create PDF Form Fields from XML Definition
create-pdf-xfa-form-from-xml.description: Shows how to load an XML file that describes form fields and programmatically add matching Aspose.Pdf form fields with default values to a new PDF document.

populate-pdf-form-from-xml.title: Populate PDF Form Fields from XML Records
populate-pdf-form-from-xml.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF template, reading XML records, matching XML element names to PDF form field names, setting values for various field types, and saving a filled PDF for each record.

extract-plain-text-from-pdf.title: Extract Plain Text from PDF for Indexing
extract-plain-text-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF generated from XML and extract its plain text using Aspose.Pdf's TextAbsorber, then optionally save the text for indexing pipelines.

export-pdf-pages-to-bmp-images.title: Export PDF Pages from XML to PNG Images
export-pdf-pages-to-bmp-images.description: Loads an XML file, converts it to a PDF document in memory using Aspose.Pdf, and saves each PDF page as a separate PNG image file.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-thumbnails.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG Thumbnails
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-thumbnails.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, and render the pages to high‑resolution PNG images for thumbnail creation.

create-png-thumbnail-from-xml.title: Generate PDF Thumbnail from First Page
create-png-thumbnail-from-xml.description: Shows how to create a PNG thumbnail image of the first page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-convert-xml-to-pdf.title: Batch Convert XML Files to PDF
batch-convert-xml-to-pdf.description: Shows how to iterate over a folder of XML files, load each with Aspose.Pdf's XmlLoadOptions, and save them as separate PDF documents.

merge-multiple-xml-pdfs.title: Merge Multiple XML‑to‑PDF Documents into a Single PDF
merge-multiple-xml-pdfs.description: The example loads several XML files, converts each to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's XmlLoadOptions, appends their pages to a target Document, and saves the combined result as a merged PDF.

split-xml-pdf-into-multiple-files.title: Split Large XML‑Generated PDF into Paginated Parts
split-xml-pdf-into-multiple-files.description: Loads a large XML dataset as a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, then divides the resulting document into multiple PDF files each limited to a set number of pages, saving them with sequentially numbered filenames.

repeat-table-header-rows.title: Repeat Table Header Rows on Each PDF Page
repeat-table-header-rows.description: Demonstrates how to create a table with a repeating header row that appears on every page when the table spans multiple PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-xml-to-pdfa-2b-and-validate.title: Validate PDF/A-2b Compliance After XML Conversion
convert-xml-to-pdfa-2b-and-validate.description: The example shows how to export a PDF to XML, reload it, convert it to PDF/A‑2b, and then validate the resulting file for PDF/A‑2b compliance using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-pdf-xml-representation.title: Extract PDF Content as XML
extract-pdf-xml-representation.description: Shows how to load a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf and export its content to an XML representation using XmlSaveOptions.

generate-html-preview-from-xml.title: Convert PDF Generated from XML to HTML Preview
generate-html-preview-from-xml.description: Shows how to load a PDF created from XML and convert it to an HTML file with embedded resources using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-xml-to-pdf-with-logging.title: Convert XML Files to PDF with Aspose.Pdf
convert-xml-to-pdf-with-logging.description: Shows how to load XML files as PDF documents using Aspose.Pdf, process multiple files, log progress, and save the resulting PDFs.

handle-malformed-xml-pdf-conversion.title: Convert PDF to XML with Exception Handling for Malformed XML
handle-malformed-xml-pdf-conversion.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, convert it to XML with XmlSaveOptions, and gracefully handle malformed XML, PDF conversion errors, and other exceptions.

handle-xslfo-parsing-errors-pdf-generati.title: Generate PDF from XML with Graceful Error Handling
handle-xslfo-parsing-errors-pdf-generati.description: Shows how to load and parse an XML file with detailed error handling, then create a simple PDF using Aspose.Pdf while handling possible PDF generation errors.

concurrent-xml-to-pdf-conversion.title: Thread‑Safe PDF Generation from XML Using Parallel Processing
concurrent-xml-to-pdf-conversion.description: Demonstrates how to convert multiple XML‑based PDF definitions to PDF files concurrently using Aspose.Pdf while ensuring thread safety.

register-aspose-pdf-generation-di.title: DI-Registered PDF Generation Service with Aspose.Pdf
register-aspose-pdf-generation-di.description: Shows how to register a PDF generation service in the .NET dependency injection container and use it to create a PDF, add text, encrypt, save, and decrypt the document with Aspose.Pdf.

batch-xml-to-pdf-conversion-profiling.title: Profile Batch XML to PDF Conversion with Aspose.Pdf
batch-xml-to-pdf-conversion-profiling.description: Demonstrates measuring load and save times while converting multiple XML files to PDF using Aspose.Pdf and provides simple bottleneck analysis.

pdf-generation-with-retry-logic.title: Retry PDF Save with Exponential Back‑off
pdf-generation-with-retry-logic.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, adding a text fragment, and saving the document using retry logic with exponential back‑off to handle transient I/O errors.

generate-pdf-from-xml-using-xslt-config.title: Generate PDF from XML using XSLT and Config File
generate-pdf-from-xml-using-xslt-config.description: The example reads XML, XSLT, and output paths from a simple key‑value config file, transforms the XML to HTML via XSLT, and then creates a PDF with Aspose.Pdf using the HTML stream.

transform-xml-xsl-to-pdf-multiple-namesp.title: Transform XML with XSLT to PDF using Aspose.Pdf
transform-xml-xsl-to-pdf-multiple-namesp.description: Demonstrates loading an XSLT stylesheet, transforming an XML document to HTML (or XSL‑FO), and converting the result to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf. No explicit namespace manager is required because the XSLT declares its namespaces.

set-pdf-page-size-via-xml-processing-ins.title: Set PDF Page Size from XML Processing Instructions
set-pdf-page-size-via-xml-processing-ins.description: The example reads processing instructions from an XML file and uses them to define the size of pages added to an Aspose.Pdf document, supporting predefined sizes and custom dimensions.

generate-pdf-from-xsl-fo.title: Convert XML to PDF using XSL‑FO with Aspose.Pdf
generate-pdf-from-xsl-fo.description: Shows how to transform an XML document with an XSL‑FO stylesheet into a PDF file by using XslCompiledTransform and Aspose.Pdf's XslFoLoadOptions.

apply-section-specific-page-margins.title: Apply Section-Specific Page Margins from XML
apply-section-specific-page-margins.description: Demonstrates loading margin definitions from an XML file and applying different margins to PDF pages based on page ranges using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-from-xml-aes256.title: Encrypt PDF from XML using AES‑256
encrypt-pdf-from-xml-aes256.description: Shows how to load a PDF from its XML representation, apply AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords and set specific permissions, then save the protected PDF.

sign-pdf-from-xml-with-certificate.title: Sign PDF Created from XML with a Certificate
sign-pdf-from-xml-with-certificate.description: The example converts an XML file to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, then adds a visible signature field and digitally signs the PDF with a PKCS#7 certificate.

split-pdf-into-chapters-by-bookmarks.title: Split PDF into Chapter Files Using Bookmarks
split-pdf-into-chapters-by-bookmarks.description: Loads a PDF, reads its top‑level bookmarks (assumed to be chapters), and creates separate PDF files for each chapter by extracting the corresponding page ranges.

xml-to-pdf-conversion-tests.title: Unit Test for XML to PDF Conversion with XSLT
xml-to-pdf-conversion-tests.description: Shows how to write NUnit tests that bind XML and XSLT to an Aspose.Pdf Document, generate a PDF, and verify the output file.
